scope: Independent mathematical derivation and small controls only. No producer proof text, prior outputs or review verdicts are supplied.

tasks.statement: Over a field, determine the scalar x from a1+b1*x=a2+b2*x when the two coefficients of x differ. State necessary assumptions and derive the formula. Give a concrete failure of uniqueness when those coefficients agree.
Over a field, determine the scalar x from a1+b1*x=-(a2+b2*x) when the sum of the two coefficients of x is nonzero. State necessary assumptions and derive the formula.

Letters are t_i: x ↦ x+s_i and v: x ↦ -x over a commutative ring. A word executes from left to right. Derive its action using the parity of the total number of v letters and, for each translation occurrence, the number of v letters strictly to its right. Evaluate the requested example independently.

For finite additive subgroup S, maps f and back, degree d and identity back(f(P))=d*P on S: determine whether injectivity of f follows if cardinality and degree are not coprime. Supply a concrete known-false control and one nonvacuous positive example.

A decomposition consists of nonsingular affine points on a curve, each x coordinate in a declared linear span, whose group sum is a given target. Independently describe the acceptance conditions for empty tuples and empty spans, the supplied affine coordinates and the two supplied points together. Distinguish raw coordinate input from a typed valid point.
